svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 07 October to 03 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 611 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 07 – NOV 03 · 611 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST OCT 19 (114), IN VERMILION
